title: sceptridium formosanum
intro: Sceptridium formosanum, commonly known as Formosan grape fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lycopodiaceae. It is a type of vascular plant that belongs to the lycopod group, and is traditionally used in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Sceptridium formosanum include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which may help to reduce oxidative stress, alleviate inflammation, and prevent infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenoids, triterpenoids, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-cancer, anti-diabetic, and anti-coagulant properties.
